title: PrimeFormance Engine
description: Offers a huge performance increase, and quality of life things.
body:
PrimeFormance is a performance modpack and has some quality of life things. Made to be liked from all player bases. And is also known as PFE as if PrimeFormance Engine.

Works in Fabric 1.21.11+

FPS bellow:
___
### Without
Non-Idle = **120-200FPS**

Idle = **200-300FPS**
### With

Non-Idle = **300-400FPS**

Idle = **470-520FPS**
___
You should use this pack for a fps boost with cool things that most players would enjoy by default.
![PrimeFormance Engine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/caeeb4069c31228b25374aadd61450594ece1263_0.webp)
This modpack has no known down side.

**If you need help or have questions** ask in the discord: https://discord.gg/EMDsHGCG4v that is where I can help you.

Get this if you like FPS.
